rules.when: Short, bounded planning or judgment call with small context: a design pick, plan, ADR draft, or narrow review that finishes in one sitting and changes no code
rules.why: Judgment work at the default effort. Raise it on a task only when the captain asks.

rules.when: Large or long implementation, including design-heavy, security-sensitive, or hard-debugging builds where judgment is the work
rules.why: A higher effort costs much more and is rarely much stronger. Raise it on a task only when the captain asks.

rules.when: Mechanical work with a known result: rename, version bump, config tweak, moving files, applying an exact spec
rules.why: A known result needs little reasoning.
